title: Human Oversight Requirement
text: AI systems should ensure meaningful human oversight, particularly in high-risk or high-impact decision-making contexts.

title: Personal Data Protection
text: Organizations deploying AI must protect personal data, prevent unauthorized access, and ensure compliance with data protection principles.

title: Security and Adversarial Safeguards
text: Developers and operators must implement safeguards against prompt injection, adversarial manipulation, and system abuse.

title: Transparency and Explainability
text: AI systems should provide transparency regarding their capabilities and limitations and offer explanations when outputs affect individuals.

title: Risk Assessment and Monitoring
text: Organizations should conduct ongoing risk assessments, monitor AI system performance, and implement mitigation measures where necessary.
